findings.description: The KMS key has no `enable_key_rotation = true`, so its backing key material is never automatically rotated. A long-lived key protecting audit bucket data means a single key compromise remains valid indefinitely.

No `policy` (key policy) is attached to this KMS key, so it falls back to the account-level default policy, which grants the entire AWS account root full control over the key. There is no explicit restriction on which principals may encrypt, decrypt, or administer the audit key.
